members.name: Arthur Mitchell
members.bio: Patriarch of the Mitchell family. A retired teacher who dedicated his life to education and community service. He instilled the values of knowledge, kindness, and perseverance in all of us.

members.name: Eleanor Mitchell
members.bio: Matriarch and the heart of our family. A nurse by profession, she has cared for generations with compassion and grace. Her Sunday dinners are legendary.

members.name: David Mitchell
members.bio: Eldest son, a successful architect who designed half the buildings downtown. He inherited his father's dedication and his mother's warmth.

members.name: Sarah Mitchell-Chen
members.bio: Our creative spirit. A painter and art teacher who sees beauty everywhere. She organizes the annual family art show and never misses a birthday.

members.name: James Mitchell
members.bio: The youngest, a free-spirited musician and composer. He travels the world collecting instruments and stories, but always comes home for the holidays.

members.name: Laura Mitchell
members.bio: David's wife, a pediatrician beloved by children and parents alike. She brings joy and laughter to every family gathering.

members.name: Emma Mitchell
members.bio: David and Laura's eldest. A bright young woman pursuing computer science. She built the first version of this family website.

members.name: Liam Mitchell
members.bio: The family athlete. Captain of the school soccer team and a talented guitarist. He has his grandmother's gift for bringing people together.

members.name: Grandma Rose
members.bio: The foundation of our family. Her recipes, stories, and unwavering love continue to guide us. She lived a full 85 years and touched everyone she met.

members.name: Grandpa Henry
members.bio: A war veteran and later a carpenter. He built the family home with his own hands and taught us that hard work and honesty are the greatest virtues.
